items.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
items.summary: Nvidia's board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, following weeks of scrutiny over an alleged affair with a Chinese national suspected of espionage and surrounding chip-smuggling allegations. CFO Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia is the linchpin of AI infrastructure, so a sudden, scandal-driven loss of its long-time CEO creates uncertainty for chip roadmaps, AI capex plans and US chip-export policy toward China.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model that replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash, rolling out today in Google Search's AI Mode, the Gemini app and all subscription tiers. It's designed to better handle complex, multi-part questions, including queries with typos or highly specific requests, breaking them down and addressing each part.
items.why_it_matters: A flagship-tier model upgrade embedded directly in Search instantly changes the AI experience for hundreds of millions of users.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its 'dots' AI agents, as well as agents in ChatGPT Work and Codex, make purchases with user approval and existing card protections. The feature is rolling out starting with ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US, beginning with eligible Amex, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards.
items.why_it_matters: It's one of the first mainstream rollouts of AI agents actually handling real-world payments, a key step toward autonomous agentic commerce.

items.title: Anthropic CEO Calls Computing Power Deepest Business Dilemma
items.summary: During Anthropic's IPO roadshow, reportedly targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation, CEO Dario Amodei named sourcing computing power as one of the company's biggest challenges, calling it its 'deepest business dilemma,' and said he isn't worried about recent market turmoil in AI stocks. In a separate roadshow conversation with JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon, he also said Anthropic doesn't want its AI agents to 'run wild' and keeps investing in safety, security and alignment.
items.why_it_matters: As one of the largest-ever tech IPOs approaches, scrutiny of Anthropic's compute costs, safety posture and market conditions will help shape how AI companies get valued going forward.

items.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.summary: New research found that China's most advanced AI models were trained using export-banned Nvidia chips, with one smuggled shipment traced to a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the figure at the center of Nvidia's recent scandal. Separately, Nvidia privately told a US lawmaker that chip-tracking to fight smuggling is technically feasible even as an industry group publicly called it infeasible, and fears of tougher export restrictions triggered a sell-off in Chinese AI stocks.
items.why_it_matters: Evidence that smuggled, export-controlled chips are powering frontier Chinese AI models intensifies pressure on US policymakers to tighten and better enforce chip export controls.

items.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away
items.summary: An OpenAI board member warned that an AI 'takeover' of society could be only months away, tracing a potential path from reward hacking in AI systems toward catastrophic, even existential, risk to humans.
items.why_it_matters: A stark warning from inside OpenAI's own governance adds weight to AI safety concerns just as frontier labs race to deploy more autonomous systems.

items.title: Cerebras pops after beating on quarterly revenue and announcing Microsoft deal
items.summary: Cerebras Systems' shares jumped after the AI chipmaker beat quarterly revenue estimates and gave stronger-than-expected sales guidance, alongside a newly announced partnership with Microsoft, following earlier deals with Amazon and Oracle.
items.why_it_matters: Strong results and a Microsoft tie-up signal that Cerebras's challenge to Nvidia in AI chips is gaining real commercial traction.

items.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
items.summary: The FAA is expanding its use of an AI advisory tool to help manage air traffic congestion across the entire US airspace. Airlines have praised the tool, but the air traffic controllers' union was not involved in the decision to expand it.
items.why_it_matters: Real-world AI deployment in safety-critical infrastructure like air traffic control raises the stakes for getting oversight and worker buy-in right.

items.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
items.summary: AI agent startup LangChain raised a $300 million round led by Alphabet's CapitalG, more than doubling its valuation to $3 billion. The company says it now has 7,000 customers for its model- and platform-agnostic agent-management tool, LangSmith.
items.why_it_matters: The round shows continued strong investor appetite for agent-infrastructure startups even as broader AI-stock sentiment wobbles.

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items.summary: The llama.cpp project released version 1.0.0, billed by its maintainers as 'a stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem.'
items.why_it_matters: llama.cpp underpins much of the local and open-weight LLM tooling ecosystem, so a 1.0 milestone signals growing maturity for running AI models on personal hardware.
